title: The multiline plugin is abnormal.
body:
## Bug Report

**Describe the bug**
I have the following problem after fluent-bit has been up for a while
The CPU usage keeps increasing until the CPU of the entire node is used up.
The memory usage of fluent-bit keep increasing, causing OOM.

**To Reproduce**
- Rubular link if applicable:
- Example log message if applicable:
```
[2024/08/22 06:29:13] [ info] [input] resume emitter_for_multiline.1
[2024/08/22 06:29:13] [ info] [input] resume tail.1
[2024/08/22 06:29:13] [ info] [input] resume tail.2
[2024/08/22 06:29:13] [ info] [input] resume tail.0
[2024/08/22 06:29:13] [ info] [input] emitter.3 resume (mem buf overlimit)
```
- Steps to reproduce the problem:

**Expected behavior**
The CPU usage and memory usage do not increase continuously

**Screenshots**

**Your Environment**
Version used: 3.1.6
Configuration:
Environment name and version (e.g. Kubernetes? What version?): Kubernetes v1.25.3
Server type and version:
Operating System and version:
Filters and plugins: tail multiline

**Additional context**
The fluent-bit.conf file in the first container is configured as follows:
```
[INPUT]
    name tail
    path /onip/log/*/var/profile/*/*.alog,/onip/log/*/var/profile/*/*.blog,xxx
    Path_Key path
    Key message
    Tag rating_profile
    Buffer_Chunk_Size 10M
    Buffer_Max_Size 10M
    Mem_Buf_Limit 10M
    Ignore_Older 1h

[INPUT]
    name tail
    path /onip/log/*/var/profile1/*/*.alog,/onip/log/*/var/profile1/*/*.blog,xxx
    Path_Key path
    Key message
    Tag rating_profile
    Buffer_Chunk_Size 10M
    Buffer_Max_Size 10M
    Mem_Buf_Limit 10M
    Ignore_Older 1h

[FILTER]
    Name modify
    Match rating_profile
    Add index_pre rating_profile
    Add formate_type rating_profile
    Add src_sys cbs_179_union_testing

[FILTER]
    name                  multiline
    match                 rating_profile
    multiline.key_content message
    multiline.parser      multiline_rating_profile

[FILTER]
    name                  grep
    match                 rating_profile
    regex                 message ^\d{8} \d{6}\.\d{3}
```
```
[MULTILINE_PARSER]
    name          multiline_rating_profile
    type          regex
    flush_timeout 1000
    rule      "start_state"   "^\d{8} \d{6}\.\d{3}"                    "cont"
    rule      "cont"          "^((?!^\d{8} \d{6}\.\d{3}).)*$" 
```
配置文件中添加了multiline
At first, the CPU usage keeps increasing. After the CPU usage reaches the top, (The CPU limits of the container are set to two cores.) The memory usage keeps increasing, and logs cannot be collected.
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/cd558df9-b2b2-44ed-83c1-06a3cf3fd922)
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/89299cf9-dd04-4e17-85f9-2d836576afdd)
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d7a2262c-54a7-46d7-9b15-34e353798877)

The configuration of the other container is as follows:
```
[INPUT]
    name tail
    path /onip/log/*/var/profile/*/*.alog,/onip/log/*/var/profile/*/*.blog,xxx
    Path_Key path
    Key message
    Tag rating_profile
    Buffer_Chunk_Size 10M
    Buffer_Max_Size 10M
    Mem_Buf_Limit 10M
    Ignore_Older 1h

[INPUT]
    name tail
    path /onip/log/*/var/profile1/*/*.alog,/onip/log/*/var/profile1/*/*.blog,xxx
    Path_Key path
    Key message
    Tag rating_profile
    Buffer_Chunk_Size 10M
    Buffer_Max_Size 10M
    Mem_Buf_Limit 10M
    Ignore_Older 1h

[FILTER]
    Name modify
    Match rating_profile
    Add index_pre rating_profile
    Add formate_type rating_profile
    Add src_sys cbs_179_union_testing

[FILTER]
    name                  grep
    match                 rating_profile
    regex                 message ^\d{8} \d{6}\.\d{3}
```
For the second container, I removed the multi-line parsing configuration. After the container was started, the CPU was stable.
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f1c5ccb5-a9d1-40d7-8646-c45e16a9b353)


I don't know if it's a problem with the configuration I wrote, or a problem with the multiline plugin.
However, the first container does collect single-line and multi-line log information in normal cases.
The second container can collect logs continuously.

comments.author: participant1
comments.body:
Hi @reporter,
to me this looks like you are reaching the limit (too high log volume). The first graph of the CPU looks like one CPU core (of your 2 CPU core limit) is fully saturated => 50% in your graph (It cannot go higher, unless you enable multi-threading). So it cannot keep up with the processing and finally the memory goes up because the buffers fill up.

comments.author: participant4
comments.body:
Confirmed here as well.  On first start, Fluent Bit CPU is normal, then gradually degrades until it consumes all available CPU.  Restart, rinse, repeat.  Issue cleared after removing the multiline filter:

```yaml
  - name: multiline
    alias: multiline
    match: syslog.application
    multiline.key_content: message
    multiline.parser: java
```

But based on what we're seeing, it will be a bit of a challenge to distill this down to a specific reproducible case with the dummy plugin.

This week we swapped rsyslog with Fluent Bit for one of our higher volume logging services, but we're seeing this CPU degradation only in one of the 8 regions.  That region happens to be the highest volume of them all, so either this is based on some load threshold or, probably more likely, it's related to some particular customer behavior and the resulting log signatures. 

Next week I will capture a few minutes of logs from that region and continuously feed it into Fluent Bit and see if I can reproduce, and if I'm able, I will start simplifying the configuration and input until I can converge on a bite-sized test case. Hopefully.

So I tried to use the example multiline config and build my own reproducer from scratch. I cannot find any other common pattern (e.g. all using kubernetes filter, all using tail DB, ...) between #9262, #8925 and #9337, other than using multiline...

```

    log_level             info

[INPUT]

#    multiline.parser      go, multiline-regex-test

script to create dummy mutliline logs (line by line):
**write_ml.sh**
```
#!/bin/bash

input_file="input.log"
output_file="test.log"
sleep_time=0.0005

while true; do
 while IFS= read -r line; do
   echo "$line" >> "$output_file"
   sleep "$sleep_time"
 done < "$input_file"
done

```

Of course the CPU will peak with constant input. The whole pipeline will run at maximum throughput - and it will settle when it is finished. This is intended behaviour. 
You can see this if you use my script to fill the file for a minute or so and change the fluent-bit.conf to 
`read_from_head true`
Leave the script running to constantly fill the input file further.
When you then start Fluent Bit it will have peak CPU load when it constantly reads existng data. Once all written data is processed, it will drop in CPU load and continue to process the newly written data constantly. 

**The issue which https://github.com/fluent/fluent-bit/issues/9262, https://github.com/fluent/fluent-bit/issues/8925 and https://github.com/fluent/fluent-bit/issues/9337 are describing is a constant increase in CPU load, which is totally different behaviour.**

[INPUT]
    name                  tail

    Tag                   test

[FILTER]

[OUTPUT]

    path                  /root/test/out
```
**parsers.conf**
```
[MULTILINE_PARSER]
    name          multiline-regex-test
    type          regex
    flush_timeout 1000
    rule         "start_state"   "/(Dec \d+ \d+\:\d+\:\d+)(.*)/"  "cont"
    rule         "cont"          "/^\s+at.*/"                     "cont"
```

**Test data generator:** 
```
#!/bin/bash

output_file="test.log"
temp_file="temp.log"
log_content="Dec 14 06:41:08 Exception in thread \"main\" java.lang.RuntimeException: Something has gone wrong, aborting!
    at com.myproject.module.MyProject.badMethod(MyProject.java:22)
    at com.myproject.module.MyProject.oneMoreMethod(MyProject.java:18)
    at com.myproject.module.MyProject.anotherMethod(MyProject.java:14)
    at com.myproject.module.MyProject.someMethod(MyProject.java:10)
    at com.myproject.module.MyProject.main(MyProject.java:6)"

target_size=$((1024 * 1024 * 1024))

echo "$log_content" > "$output_file"

# Duplicate the file by copying it to itself until it reaches the target size
current_size=$(stat -c%s "$output_file")

echo "$log_content" > "$output_file"
while [[ $current_size -lt $target_size ]]; do
        cp "$output_file" "$temp_file"
        cat "$temp_file" >> "$output_file"
        current_size=$(stat -c%s "$output_file")
done
truncate -s $target_size "$output_file"
rm "$temp_file"
```
